title: Idempotent Payments API
instructions: Build `POST /payments` in `main.py` with a required `Idempotency-Key` header: the first request returns 201, an identical retry returns 200 with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and the same payment, and a different body under the same key returns 409. Every error uses the envelope `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields"}}`, and the endpoint is a plain `def` guarded by `_LOCK` so concurrent retries stay correct.

evidence.label: The first request returns 201 with a captured payment and no replay header
An identical retry returns 200, the same payment and Idempotent-Replayed: true
Reusing a key with a different body returns 409 idempotency_key_reuse in the envelope
A missing key returns 422 validation_error with a field location naming the header
Reports invalid body fields by dotted location and enforces amount, currency and customer limits
20 concurrent identical requests produce one 201, nineteen 200s and one stored payment
The endpoint is a plain def mounted at /payments
